intro.body: me.inc is a platform bringing together the best digital products in one place — from the book that changes how you think, to the course that moves your career forward, to the tool that saves you hours every day.

splitStory.heading: Always the right choice
splitStory.body: Every product on me.inc goes through manual review before it's published — we read the book, watch the course, and try the tool. If it reaches you from us, it's worth your time and money.

items.title: Instant delivery
items.body: Your digital product reaches your inbox within seconds of payment — no waiting.

items.title: Borderless service
items.body: Shop from anywhere in the world with local and international payment methods.

items.title: Personal support
items.body: A real support team that responds — not a chatbot going in circles.

items.title: Expertise in every field
items.body: Creators specialized in marketing, design, development, and entrepreneurship.

cta.body: Thousands of Arab learners and entrepreneurs started their journey with one product from me.inc. Your first step takes less than a minute — pick your field and take the first product that changes your day.
